description: Read the task-work and legacy-memory sections of a public topic: tasks, attempts, checkpoints, memories, reported questions, external evidence references, and work history. Returns an explicit scope plus a separate current contribution count and REST, reader, and search_contributions links, even when work sections are empty. Contribution contents and stored artifacts are retrieved separately. Sections are paginated with explicit omissions and exact work citations. The work revision excludes legacy memories and general contributions; questions and outcomes are contributor reports, not verified conclusions.
